title: GDD T-112c — Special COOP phase §7.1 (ronda 3-4 coop scenario) [split from TASK-041]
description:
Split slice 3 of TASK-041. Build the special COOPERATIVE phase per GDD §7.1 — a 60-90 s scenario composed from the MECH_08/MECH_09 mechanics (TASK-076/TASK-077). Engine-free Core, seeded, zero-alloc, tests-first (tdd).

GDD §7.1 rules: ALL avatars have UNIFORM movement stats — difficulty comes 100% from level ARCHITECTURE, never from per-player stat differences (structural guarantee). The four ergonomic-violation elements are composable LEVEL DATA: distanciasEstiradas (stretched distances), interseccionForzada (forced intersection — the ONLY place inter-player collision is ON), cuelloBotella (bottleneck), sueloDinamico (dynamic floor activating at t=30 s). Positive scoring only, with bronze/plata/oro thresholds paying 2/4/6 coins to ALL players equally (coop, no internal ranking — P2). Read GDD §7.1 + the MECH_08/09 implementations before coding.

Integrates with the Sequencer quota (exactly 1 coop special per session) — that wiring is the parent TASK-041's AC6, not this ticket; this ticket delivers the phase itself + its level-data model + scoring. Fast-suite testable; no Unity gate.
acceptance_criteria: The coop phase composes MECH_08/MECH_09 into a 60-90 s scenario; engine-free, seeded, zero-alloc steady tick, determinism lock
All 4 avatars share IDENTICAL movement params (structural assert — no per-player stat branch); difficulty is expressed only through level data

The 4 ergonomic-violation elements (distanciasEstiradas, interseccionForzada, cuelloBotella, sueloDinamico@t=30s) exist as composable level data; inter-player collision is active ONLY in this phase (specifically interseccionForzada), verified off elsewhere
bronze/plata/oro score thresholds pay exactly 2/4/6 coins to ALL players equally (coop payout, no internal ranking, P2)
Tests-first; full fast suite green after, no regression

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
HELD (blocked) pending HUMAN DESIGN ADJUDICATION — rev-t078 REQUEST-CHANGES (1 HIGH / 2 MEDIUM). Dev commits b97241a (test) / d609af4 (feat) are on local master (823/0 fast, additive, NOT pushed as done). NOT closed.

HIGH-1 (GDD-semantic, human-only decision — no dev retry, no auth switch lifts it): the delivered model is STRICTLY SEQUENTIAL — the whole engaged team converges on ONE station at a time (CoopPhaseMicrogame.cs:236-257, _currentObjectiveIndex++). rev-t078 confirms this PASSES the literal ACs (AC3 is written narrowly: elements 'exist as composable level data' + 'collision only here') BUT hollows out 2 of the 4 GDD §7.1 ergonomic elements per the canonical text (Barcade_GDD_Tecnico.md:517): interseccionForzada='rutas óptimas cruzadas en X' (crossed routes require SIMULTANEOUS distinct destinations — a converging blob merges, never crosses) and sueloDinamico='las asignaciones deben renegociarse' (renegotiating a per-player division of labor — the sequential-together model has no assignments substrate). §7 lives under pillar P2 (max coordination); the catalog exists to force SIMULTANEOUS distributed coordination. Flagged HIGH to force a conscious accept/reject since GDD is canonical. THE FORK (human): (A) ACCEPT sequential as the Core-slice scope for now + tracked follow-up to restore simultaneous assignments/crossed-routing later -> downgrades to a documented deviation, primitives all reusable, then fix the 2 MEDIUMs + close; or (B) REBUILD now as simultaneous spatially-distributed multi-station (substantially larger: per-seat station assignments, concurrent sub-mechanic play, crossed-route geometry).

MEDIUM-1 (fix regardless of the fork, per reviewer): shipped GddDefaults sueloDinamico is HALF-INERT — CoopLevelData.cs:121-138 places objectives 0/1 on the main diagonal (0.1,0.1)/(0.9,0.9), and ApplyDynamicFloorShift is an X/Y swap (reflection across the main diagonal) = literal no-op for diagonal objectives, so at t=30s only objectives 2<->3 move. The dedicated test uses off-diagonal coords so the suite never catches it. Concrete content defect.

MEDIUM-2: cuelloBotella walls hardcoded at (0.5,0.35)/(0.5,0.65) regardless of objective layout (CoopPhaseMicrogame.cs:115-116,373-394) — non-composable unlike the other elements; make wall geometry level data.

FIRSTHAND CONFIRMED PASSING (rev-t078): AC1 composition-not-reimplementation (real Sujeta/Iguala sub-instances built once in ctor, Initialize'd once, InputSnapshot forwarded verbatim; sub-mechanics use own internal _tick so global-tick forwarding is safe; +1/-1 can't mis-score) + zero-alloc mutation-proven; AC2 uniform movement (one AvatarSpeed field, no per-seat branch); AC3 each element ON/OFF + reviewer's OWN grep confirms ResolveAvatarCollisions is the ONLY avatar-vs-avatar collision in Core (Esquiva=avatar-vs-hazard); AC4 exact 2/4/6 9-case boundary sweep + never-zero (§6.1) + real end-to-end ApplyCoop identical payout + Ranks.Empty structural; abandonment via IsEngagedSeat (idle can't block arrival); no existing test weakened (additive only). Orchestrator fast gate 823/0.

LOW/notes carried: [ASSUMED]#9 no bot policy — a bot-occupied seat counts as engaged for arrival but supplies no input, could stall a sub-mechanic (Sujeta hold); flag for TASK-041 sequencer wiring. [ASSUMED]#1 self-validates [60,90]s (no [3,8]s microgame validator) — defensible. [ASSUMED]#8 merged RenderState deferred to Framework presenter.

ORCHESTRATOR ACTION: TASK-078 -> blocked; loop continues on independent TASK-079 (Jefe phase) then TASK-069/071/074; TASK-041 epic stays blocked (dep on TASK-078). Human adjudicates HIGH-1 on return; then MEDIUM fixes + close (path A) or rebuild (path B).
